mapper.sql: tm.id, tm.tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, tm.machine_id, tm.mac_address, tm.host_name, tm.remark, tm.status, tm.created_by, tm.created_at, tm.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_machine (tenant_id, machine_id, mac_address, host_name, remark, status, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{machineId}, #{macAddress}, #{hostName}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tenant_machine tm LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = tm.tenant_id WHERE tm.machine_id = #{machineId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM tenant_machine tm LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = tm.tenant_id WHERE tm.mac_address = #{macAddress} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM tenant_machine tm LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id = tm.tenant_id WHERE tm.status = 1 AND ( (#{machineId} IS NOT NULL AND #{machineId} != '' AND tm.machine_id = #{machineId}) OR (#{macAddress} IS NOT NULL AND #{macAddress} != '' AND tm.mac_address = #{macAddress}) ) ORDER BY tm.id DESC LIMIT 1
